title: The engine turns over slowly before it starts

turns.question: When I try to start the car, the engine turns over really slowly before it catches. Once it starts it runs smoothly. What should the technician look at first?

records.observation: Current job SC-201. Complaint: slow cranking before starting; normal running afterwards. No current diagnostic checks recorded.

turns.question: The workshop has sent the battery report. What does this tell us to check next?

records.observation: SC-201, current completed applicable load protocol: battery LOAD voltage 9.1 V while the slow cranking was reproduced. This is not resting voltage.

turns.question: It spun normally with another battery. Is that enough to tell the customer the original one caused it?

records.observation: SC-201, battery-only comparison: A original battery gives slow rotation; B reference battery gives normal rotation. Starter, cables, temperature and test conditions are verified unchanged. The original battery return observation has not been recorded.

turns.question: The technician has now completed the return observation. What can we say to the customer?

records.observation: SC-201 completion of the same battery-only comparison: A2 original battery restored slow rotation. Only the battery changed through A, B and A2. Starter, cables, temperature and test conditions were verified unchanged throughout. All observations belong to this current job.

replacements.observation: SC-201 complete A2 observation: original battery also gave normal rotation. All A-B-A2 controls and unchanged conditions passed; only the battery changed. Slow cranking did not recur.

route: complete battery comparison does not localise

replacements.observation: SC-201 current completed battery load report: reading 9.1. The unit is omitted.
SC-201 current completed applicable load protocol: battery LOAD voltage 9.5 V.

records.observation: SC-201 completed current cranking return-path drop 0.3 V. No component localisation is recorded.

replacements.observation: SC-201 completed current applicable load protocol: battery LOAD voltage 10.2 V.

records.observation: SC-201 completed current cranking return-path drop 0.6 V.

replacements.observation: SC-201 completed current applicable load protocol: battery LOAD voltage 10.2 V.

title: The charging light comes on while driving

turns.question: The battery-shaped warning comes on after the engine is already running, then goes away. Starting feels normal. What information should I give the technician?

records.observation: Current job CH-302. Intermittent charging warning during otherwise normal engine running. No current drive inspection or charging log supplied.

turns.question: The workshop has checked the drive and logged the warning episode. Where does that point us next?

records.observation: CH-302 current completed workshop report verifies intact charging-drive engagement throughout the reported warning episode.
CH-302 current completed applicable charging-voltage log covers the reproduced warning episode: 12.4 V during the warning, with the measurement context confirmed.

turns.question: The warning disappeared with the reference charging unit. Can we conclude anything yet?

records.observation: CH-302 current comparison: A original unit has the warning and 12.4 V; B reference unit has no warning and 14.2 V. Wiring, battery, drive, load and measurement context are verified unchanged; only the charging unit changes. A2 return observation is still missing.

turns.question: The original unit's return result is attached. What is the supported customer answer?

records.observation: CH-302 same comparison A2: original charging unit returned, warning recurred and charging voltage returned to 12.4 V. All A-B-A2 wiring, battery, drive, load and measurement-context controls were verified unchanged; only the charging unit changed.
CH-302 completed current inspection reports failed charging-drive engagement during the warning episode.

replacements.observation: CH-302 complete applicable current charging-voltage log throughout the warning episode: 13.6 V; measurement context verified. The entire log stays at this value.
CH-302 complete applicable current charging-voltage log throughout the warning episode: 14.8 V; measurement context verified. The entire log stays at this value.

CH-302 complete same-job A2: returned original unit gives no warning and 14.2 V. All wiring, battery, drive, load and measurement controls were verified unchanged; only the unit changed. The original abnormal pattern did not recur.
